verdict.rationale: BVNK documents the core off-ramp flow: it explicitly offers to "fund in stablecoins and pay out in fiat" and to accept stablecoins and settle in fiat. Its fiat payout docs cover first- and third-party payouts to bank accounts from USD/EUR/GBP virtual accounts, across a claimed 130+ countries. missing for 10: named payout rails (e.g., SEPA/ACH/Faster Payments), a published per-country/per-currency payout coverage list beyond USD/EUR/GBP, and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end stablecoin-to-bank off-ramping.
